name: Colón
shape: geoBoundaries, the department it is named for

climate: Most rain falls while the vines grow. Damp leaves invite mildew and rot, so growers spray more and pick carefully.

blurb.text: An Argentine geographical indication in Córdoba province that holds the smaller Colonia Caroya. Isabella is the most planted grape at 23%, followed by Pinot Noir at 19%, Merlot at 15% and Malbec at 14%.
